title: Arctic Sea Ice Minimum 2026
summary: The smallest extent of Arctic sea ice in 2026, at the end of the summer melt.
soundIdea: A held chord that thins out as the ice shrinks.

title: El Niño 2026: Sea Surface Temperature Anomaly
summary: How much warmer or cooler the Pacific is than normal, 2025 against 2026, updated daily.
soundIdea: Pitch rises with warmer than normal water; a new day, a new note.

title: Global Ocean Colour from PACE
summary: The apparent colour of the world's ocean from NASA's PACE satellite, updated daily.
soundIdea: Bluer water sounds brighter, greener water sounds warmer and softer.

title: Sea Surface Height Anomaly
summary: Where the sea stands higher or lower than normal, updated weekly.
soundIdea: A slow swell in volume that follows the rising sea.

title: Canadian Wildfire Smoke over the United States
summary: Smoke from the 2026 Canadian wildfires carried into the United States, 14 to 20 July 2026.
soundIdea: A hiss that thickens as the smoke spreads.

title: Hurricane Polo Makes Landfall in Baja California
summary: Hurricane Polo crossing onto the coast of Baja California.
soundIdea: A rhythm that quickens as the storm strengthens and pans as it moves.

title: Super Typhoon Bavi
summary: The path and strength of Super Typhoon Bavi in July 2026.
soundIdea: A rising drone that follows the typhoon's strength.

title: Mapping Snow Drought in the Pacific Northwest
summary: Snow cover and an atmospheric river across the 2025 to 2026 winter.
soundIdea: Sparse bell notes where snow is missing.

title: Terrestrial Water Storage Trends from GRACE
summary: Where land has been gaining or losing water, measured from gravity by GRACE and GRACE-FO.
soundIdea: Rising notes for regions gaining water, falling notes for regions drying out.

title: 2026 Ozone Hole Update
summary: The size of the 2026 ozone hole over Antarctica.
soundIdea: A gap in the chord that widens with the hole.

title: The Retreating Alsek Glacier, Alaska
summary: Decades of Landsat images of the Alsek Glacier pulling back.
soundIdea: A low note that steps down year by year as the ice retreats.

title: Tracking Timber in Washington's Wynoochee Valley
summary: Forest cut and regrowth in the Wynoochee Valley from Landsat and Sentinel-2.
soundIdea: A woody pulse that drops out where trees are cut.
